title: Add validated console issue write API for comments and state transitions
description: Add authenticated/local console mutation endpoints and client support for normal Kanbus comments and configured status transitions. Reuse canonical Python/Rust validation and event history; enforce workflow transitions, conflict/fencing behavior, and useful errors. Successful writes update the snapshot/realtime path and Git refresh fallback. Do not add arbitrary direct JSON editing.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Already shipped: PR #344 (merged, live on main) adds POST /api/issues/:id/comments and /status to both console backends (kbsc and the Node dev server), reusing the canonical Rust/Python update_issue path so workflow transitions, validation, and event history all go through the same logic the CLI uses. Writes are localhost-only (decided explicitly: no per-user auth for the local console). Closing to avoid a duplicate router run.
